responsibility: Implements the RTL auto-inc/auto-dec discovery pass that rewrites separate pointer-adjust and memory-reference instructions into target-supported pre/post increment, decrement, or modify addressing modes. It scans each basic block with DF use/def information, recognizes a fixed set of increment-plus-memory patterns, consults a target-dependent decision table built from HAVE_PRE_INCREMENT/HAVE_POST_MODIFY_* style capabilities, and replaces matching address expressions while preserving debug/value-tracking constraints; the pass is registered as the RTL pass "auto_inc_dec".
